translations.web: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
translations.bsb: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
translations.kjv: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher
translations.asv: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
